sourceText:
Minty Summer Sunshine!
By: purabi naha
Published: Sunday, June 12, 2011 - 7:17pm

Ingredients




1/2 cup Mango pulp:
2 Lychees:
2 tablespoons Lemon juice:
1/4 cup Apple, chopped finely:
4 Mint leaves:
2 tablespoons Brown sugar:
1/4 teaspoon Salt:
4 tablespoons Yogurt:
2 cups Drinking water:
1/2 cup Crushed ice:
3 tablespoons Honey, divided:

Preparation

1 Reserve some chopped apples and 1 tbsp honey for putting at the bottom of the serving glass. 2 Add all the ingredients, except water, to the blender and blend all to a smooth paste. 3 Add the water and blend once more. 4 Take out a frosted glass from the refrigerator, put the reserved apples in it. Pour honey (1 tbsp) over it. Now, pour the minty smoothie. Serve chilled.

About


This is the recipe of the amazing smoothie I made this morning. The mint, lychee, apple and the mango made a great match with each other in this fruity delight. Then, there are lemon and honey into it, along with the yogurt. All blended, this is the tasty surprise I got, which my family enjoyed till the last drop. Actually, I wasn’t expecting that it would turn out to be so delicious; but, it did!
